title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates (0.03, 0.03) with a radius of 0.03. Draw the second loop as another circle centered at the same coordinates but with a smaller radius of 0.015. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.06. Rotate and translate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translation vector values. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object with a rounded bottom and a flat top are 0.06 units in length, 0.06 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.03, 0.03)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.03)       # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.015)      # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder
